# pinka command

`pinka` operates a provisioned lab host. Bootstrap installs it to `/usr/local/bin/pinka` and writes the lab description `/etc/pinka/lab.json` it reads (see [Doctor checks](../doctor-checks.md) and [Exit codes](../exit-codes.md)).

```text
pinka [-h] [--config FILE] [--version] COMMAND ...
```

Operate a Pokus lab host: health checks, fingerprint, start and stop, backups, golden images, researchers, inference node pairing, host updates and the documentation.

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-h`, `--help`.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | — | — | show the help of pinka or of a command and exit |
| `--config` | `FILE` | `/etc/pinka/lab.json` | lab description written by bootstrap |
| `--version` | — | — | show program's version number and exit |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `pinka preflight` | run preflight read-only |
| `pinka doctor` | run the health and security checks (root) |
| `pinka status` | units, containers, Incus instances, GPU, disk and last backup |
| `pinka start` | start pinka-lab.target (root) |
| `pinka stop` | drain the orchestrator, then stop pinka-lab.target (root) |
| `pinka fingerprint` | print the environment fingerprint and its hash |
| `pinka backup` | back up now or list the snapshots (root) |
| `pinka restore` | run bootstrap with --restore (root) |
| `pinka images` | golden images: list, build, export |
| `pinka images list` | aliases, fingerprints, build time and export state |
| `pinka images build` | build missing images, or one blueprint (root) |
| `pinka images export` | export images that lack an export and check every export (root) |
| `pinka user` | edit the researcher list of the configuration (never the host) |
| `pinka user add` | add a researcher |
| `pinka user remove` | lock a researcher (moved to researchers_removed) |
| `pinka user keys` | replace a researcher's public keys |
| `pinka pair` | pair a lab node with an inference node over the tailnet (root) |
| `pinka pair show` | on the inference node: show a code and wait |
| `pinka pair connect` | on the lab node: pair with the inference node |
| `pinka wsl-helpers` | where the optional Windows helpers are (wsl2 only) |
| `pinka update-host` | drain, update the OS keeping the holds, bootstrap, doctor, fingerprint diff (root) |
| `pinka platform` | the lab's platform (root) |
| `pinka platform purge` | remove a replaced platform's releases, state, restricted area and database (root) |
| `pinka docs` | the documentation of the lab |
| `pinka docs serve` | serve the built documentation read-only on 127.0.0.1 |

### pinka preflight

Run preflight read-only.

```text
pinka preflight [-h] [--json]
```

| Argument | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | — | — | print the JSON report |

### pinka doctor

Run the health and security checks (root).

```text
pinka doctor [-h] [--json] [--smoke]
```

| Argument | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | — | — | print the report as JSON |
| `--smoke` | — | — | also launch a throwaway target of every golden image |

### pinka status

Units, containers, Incus instances, GPU, disk and last backup.

```text

```

### pinka start

Start pinka-lab.target (root).

```text

```

### pinka stop

Drain the orchestrator, then stop pinka-lab.target (root).

```text
pinka stop [-h] [--timeout SECONDS]
```

| Argument | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--timeout` | `SECONDS` | `1800` | how long the drain may take |

### pinka fingerprint

Print the environment fingerprint and its hash.

```text
pinka fingerprint [-h] [--json]
```

| Argument | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | — | — | print the whole fingerprint as JSON |

### pinka backup

Back up now or list the snapshots (root).

```text
pinka backup [-h] {now,list}
```

| Argument | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `now`, `list` | — | now: dump the database and back up; list: this host's snapshots |

### pinka restore

Run bootstrap.sh with --restore. Bootstrap options follow `--`, as in `pinka restore -- --non-interactive`.

```text
pinka restore [-h] [BOOTSTRAP_OPTION ...]
```

| Argument | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BOOTSTRAP_OPTION` (optional) | — | — | passed to bootstrap.sh (after --) |

### pinka images build

Build missing images, or one blueprint (root).

```text
pinka images build [-h] [--rebuild] [blueprint]
```

| Argument | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blueprint` (optional) | — | — | blueprint to build (with the blueprints it starts from) |
| `--rebuild` | — | — | build the blueprint again although its image exists |

### pinka images export

Export images that lack an export and check every export (root).

```text

```

### pinka docs serve

Serve the built documentation read-only on 127.0.0.1.

```text
pinka docs serve [-h] [--dir DIR] [--port PORT]
```

| Argument | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--dir` | `DIR` | — | built documentation site (default: docs.dir of the lab description, /usr/local/share/pinka/docs) |
| `--port` | `PORT` | — | port (default: docs.port of the lab description, 18706) |

Exit codes: 0 success; 1 failure (doctor: warnings only); 2 usage error (doctor: a check of severity error failed). See [Exit codes](../exit-codes.md).
